name: Europelta
sum: Europelta is the most complete ankylosaur known from Europe, a large struthiosaurin nodosaurid from the Albian of Teruel, Spain.
wsnote: Estimates given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: A partial skeleton — Escucha Formation, locality AR-1 near Ariño, Teruel Province, Spain.
material: Two associated partial skeletons (holotype and paratype).
biology: A large nodosaurid; its mandible, osteoderms and limbs are described in the original paper.
author: Kirkland et al. 2013
